title: Plain-English lint for code, diffs, commits and docs
description: Check code, diffs, commit messages or docs against a plain-English team rule (swallowed errors, secrets, commit matches diff)

text.description:
one function, hunk, message, or 'Commit message:
...

Staged diff:
...'

profile.description: the check, one per run so a blocking check is asked alone: strict = swallows, secret, commit_mismatch, comment_contradicts, prose_slop, naming (advisory score)

steps.when: grey(swallows) or grey(secret) or grey(mismatch) or grey(contradicts) or grey(slop)

swallows.instructions: Does this function silently swallow an exception, meaning it catches an error and neither logs it, re-raises it, nor reports it to the caller?

secret.instructions: Does the added code contain a real, working-looking credential written as a string literal? A placeholder such as YOUR_API_KEY_HERE, <token>, xxx or changeme is not a real credential.

mismatch.instructions: Does the commit message describe a change that is NOT present in the diff?

contradicts.instructions: Does the comment describe behavior that differs from what the code does?

slop.instructions: Is this paragraph written in generic AI-sounding marketing filler, using stock phrases such as 'delve', 'tapestry', 'unlock the full potential' or 'in today's fast-paced world'?

naming.instructions: How descriptive are the function and variable names in this code?

combine: block if secret >= block_at; warn if swallows >= warn_at or secret >= warn_at or mismatch >= warn_at or contradicts >= warn_at or slop >= warn_at or naming <= naming_warn; ignore otherwise
limitations: sibling interference: a check is 0.996 alone and 0.33 co-asked, so each check is its own run
the lowest true positive 0.68 is ambiguous by definition
state is a snippet (no repo-wide claims)
naming is an advisory score and never blocks; prose_slop and swallows never block
custom team rules ({id, claim, true_means, false_means}) and several checks per call are not built: one profile per run
notes: # deviation: spec 5.6: the check is the `profile` input (one question set per run; `strict` is the swallows check); only secrets block (>= 0.9), every other check warns at >= 0.7; samples 4 is a re-read taken only when the first read is grey (0.2-0.8), so a confident first read is one request; the comment_contradicts question is the case wording without its case-specific tail
